summary: EcoMOF-AI organizes material records, descriptors, separation conditions, catalytic hypotheses, evidence status, and validation needs into a transparent decision-support workflow.
summaryZh: EcoMOF-AI 将材料记录、描述符、分离条件、催化假设、证据状态和验证需求组织成透明的决策支持流程。

methodWorkflow.label: Data source
methodWorkflow.description: Start from curated literature, seed datasets, and explicit demonstration records.
methodWorkflow.descriptionZh: 从已整理文献、种子数据集和显式边界的演示记录开始。

methodWorkflow.label: Descriptor / condition extraction
methodWorkflow.description: Extract descriptors, gas-separation conditions, catalytic pathway annotations, and validation fields.
methodWorkflow.descriptionZh: 提取描述符、气体分离条件、催化路径注释和验证字段。

methodWorkflow.label: Field-level provenance
methodWorkflow.description: Attach source, location, evidence type, and curation status to fields that drive interpretation.
methodWorkflow.descriptionZh: 为影响解释的字段绑定来源、位置、证据类型和整理状态。

methodWorkflow.label: Task-specific scoring / comparison
methodWorkflow.labelZh: 任务特定评分 / 比较
methodWorkflow.description: Use module-specific comparison logic instead of a single black-box ranking.
methodWorkflow.descriptionZh: 使用模块特定比较逻辑，而不是单一黑箱排名。

methodWorkflow.label: Candidate explanation
methodWorkflow.description: Expose drivers, warnings, missing fields, and validation gaps.
methodWorkflow.descriptionZh: 展示驱动因素、警告、缺失字段和验证缺口。

visualizations.title: Evidence-aware method flow
visualizations.description: Data source to descriptor extraction to provenance to comparison to validation roadmap.
visualizations.descriptionZh: 从数据来源到描述符提取、来源绑定、比较和验证路线。

evidenceBoundary: Decision-support prototype, not a black-box validated ranking tool.
Outputs require module-specific validation before scientific claims.
evidenceBoundaryZh: 决策支持原型，不是黑箱式已验证排名工具。
任何输出都需要模块特定验证后才能作为科研结论。
validationRoadmap: connect field-level provenance to each derived output
add experiment and DFT feedback loops
validationRoadmapZh: 将字段级来源连接到每个派生输出
接入实验与 DFT 反馈循环

methodGroups.title: Evidence-aware decision workflow
methodGroups.purpose: Make every module read as an explainable research workflow rather than an isolated ranking screen.
methodGroups.purposeZh: 让每个模块都呈现为可解释研究流程，而不是孤立排名界面。

algorithmSteps.label: Collect records
algorithmSteps.description: Use source-linked records with explicit data status.
algorithmSteps.descriptionZh: 使用带来源和数据状态的记录。

algorithmSteps.label: Normalize evidence fields
algorithmSteps.description: Keep reviewed, pending, estimated, and missing states visible.
algorithmSteps.descriptionZh: 保持 reviewed、pending、estimated、missing 状态可见。

algorithmSteps.label: Apply module logic
algorithmSteps.description: Choose scoring, condition comparison, or pathway reasoning according to task.
algorithmSteps.descriptionZh: 按任务选择评分、条件比较或路径推理。

visualizations.title: Workflow cards
visualizations.description: Module summaries, method steps, formulas, warnings, and validation roadmap.
visualizations.descriptionZh: 模块摘要、方法步骤、公式、警告和验证路线。

limitations: The platform provides structured reasoning support; it does not replace laboratory validation.
limitationsZh: 平台提供结构化推理支持，不能替代实验室验证。

summary: EcoScreen combines task-specific filtering, descriptor weighting, evidence confidence, and sensitivity checks to preview sustainability and feasibility signals.
summaryZh: EcoScreen 结合任务筛选、描述符赋权、证据置信度和敏感性检查，预览可持续性与可行性信号。

methodWorkflow.label: Task-specific filtering
methodWorkflow.description: Select candidates and descriptors relevant to the screening question.
methodWorkflow.descriptionZh: 选择与筛选问题相关的候选物和描述符。

methodWorkflow.label: Direction-aware normalization
methodWorkflow.description: Normalize benefit and cost indicators with consistent direction.
methodWorkflow.descriptionZh: 按一致方向归一化收益型与成本型指标。

methodWorkflow.label: CRITIC objective weighting
methodWorkflow.description: Estimate information content from descriptor contrast and non-redundancy.
methodWorkflow.descriptionZh: 由描述符区分度和非冗余性估计信息量。

methodWorkflow.label: Evidence confidence correction
methodWorkflow.description: Scale raw scores using evidence confidence Q.
methodWorkflow.descriptionZh: 用证据置信度 Q 修正原始分数。

methodWorkflow.label: Sensitivity and validation gaps
methodWorkflow.description: Report robustness and fields that would change interpretation.
methodWorkflow.descriptionZh: 报告稳健性和可能改变解释的字段缺口。

outputsZh: 风险 / 验证缺口输出

visualizations.title: CRITIC weight distribution
visualizations.description: Shows which indicators carry higher contrast and lower redundancy in the current candidate set.
visualizations.descriptionZh: 展示当前候选集中哪些指标具有更高区分度和更低冗余。

visualizations.title: Sensitivity analysis
visualizations.description: Shows how ranking or tier assignment changes under weight perturbation.
visualizations.descriptionZh: 展示权重扰动下排序或分层如何变化。

evidenceBoundary: EcoScreen is a decision-support preview, not a validated performance or environmental prediction.
CRITIC weights describe the current candidate set and should not be generalized without validation.
evidenceBoundaryZh: EcoScreen 是决策支持预览，不是已验证性能或环境预测。
CRITIC 权重描述当前候选集，未经验证不应外推。
validationRoadmap: compare with measured stability and toxicity data
repeat sensitivity analysis after data updates
validationRoadmapZh: 与实测稳定性和毒性数据对照
数据更新后重复敏感性分析

methodGroups.title: CRITIC objective weighting
methodGroups.purpose: Estimate descriptor weights from contrast intensity and conflict with other indicators.
methodGroups.purposeZh: 根据指标区分度及其与其他指标的冲突程度估计描述符权重。

algorithmSteps.label: Normalize indicators
algorithmSteps.description: Bring all descriptors to a comparable 0-1 scale.
algorithmSteps.descriptionZh: 将所有描述符转换到可比较的 0-1 尺度。

algorithmSteps.label: Compute standard deviation
algorithmSteps.description: Use sigma to represent contrast intensity across candidates.
algorithmSteps.descriptionZh: 用 sigma 表示候选集内的区分度。

algorithmSteps.label: Compute correlation conflict
algorithmSteps.description: Lower redundancy against other indicators increases information content.
algorithmSteps.descriptionZh: 与其他指标冗余越低，信息量越高。

algorithmSteps.label: Normalize weights
algorithmSteps.description: Convert information content into weights that sum to one.
algorithmSteps.descriptionZh: 将信息量转换为总和为 1 的权重。

formulas.label: CRITIC information content
formulas.explanation: C_j increases when descriptor j has high spread and low redundancy.
formulas.explanationZh: 当描述符 j 具有高区分度且与其他指标低冗余时，C_j 增大。

formulas.label: CRITIC weight
formulas.explanation: Information content is normalized into a weight vector.
formulas.explanationZh: 信息量被归一化为权重向量。

visualizations.title: Weight diagnostics
visualizations.description: Bar chart and conflict-oriented explanation for each descriptor.
visualizations.descriptionZh: 每个描述符的柱状图和冲突解释。

limitations: CRITIC indicates information contribution in the current candidate set; it does not prove descriptor causality.
limitationsZh: CRITIC 表示当前候选集中指标的信息贡献，不证明描述符因果作用。

methodGroups.title: Candidate score with evidence confidence
methodGroups.titleZh: 带证据置信度的候选评分
methodGroups.purpose: Combine weighted descriptors with a gate and evidence confidence correction.
methodGroups.purposeZh: 将加权描述符、门槛函数和证据置信度修正组合起来。

algorithmSteps.label: Apply gate G
algorithmSteps.description: Exclude or penalize candidates that fail required feasibility constraints.
algorithmSteps.descriptionZh: 排除或惩罚不满足基本可行性约束的候选物。

algorithmSteps.label: Aggregate descriptors
algorithmSteps.description: Use a weighted geometric form to avoid one descriptor dominating by scale.
algorithmSteps.descriptionZh: 使用加权几何形式，避免单个描述符因尺度主导。

algorithmSteps.label: Apply evidence confidence
algorithmSteps.description: Scale the raw score by Q to reflect data quality.
algorithmSteps.descriptionZh: 用 Q 缩放原始评分以反映数据质量。

formulas.label: Candidate raw score
formulas.explanation: G applies hard feasibility constraints; d_j are normalized descriptors.
formulas.explanationZh: G 表示硬性可行性约束；d_j 为归一化描述符。

formulas.label: Evidence confidence correction
formulas.explanation: Q reduces apparent priority when evidence is weak, pending, or incomplete.
formulas.explanationZh: 当证据较弱、待整理或不完整时，Q 会降低表观优先级。

visualizations.title: Candidate score cards
visualizations.description: Score, confidence, explanation, and missing-field warnings.
visualizations.descriptionZh: 评分、置信度、解释和缺失字段警告。

limitations: Scores are used for screening discussions and should not be read as measured material performance.
limitationsZh: 评分用于筛选讨论，不应被解读为实测材料性能。

methodGroups.title: Sensitivity and robustness analysis
methodGroups.purpose: Check whether candidate priority is stable under weight and evidence perturbations.
methodGroups.purposeZh: 检查权重和证据扰动下候选优先级是否稳定。

algorithmSteps.label: Perturb weights
algorithmSteps.description: Apply controlled changes to descriptor weights.
algorithmSteps.descriptionZh: 对描述符权重施加受控变化。

algorithmSteps.label: Recompute scores
algorithmSteps.description: Re-run candidate scoring under each perturbation.
algorithmSteps.descriptionZh: 在每次扰动下重新计算候选评分。

algorithmSteps.label: Report instability
algorithmSteps.description: Flag candidates whose tier changes under small perturbations.
algorithmSteps.descriptionZh: 标记小扰动下分层发生变化的候选物。

visualizations.title: Sensitivity curve
visualizations.description: Shows score or tier variation after perturbation.
visualizations.descriptionZh: 展示扰动后的评分或分层变化。

limitations: Sensitivity analysis only probes model assumptions; it does not validate candidate behavior.
limitationsZh: 敏感性分析只检验模型假设，不能验证候选物行为。

summary: GasSep treats uptake and selectivity as condition-bound records, explains adsorption with paired pure-component isotherms, Henry affinity, scenario IAST, and isosteric heat, then ranks candidates with literature-grounded Pareto/APS, APS×R%, CRITIC, and clearly marked legacy GasScore modes.
summaryZh: GasSep 将吸附量和选择性视为绑定工况的记录，使用双组分纯气等温线、Henry 亲和、情景 IAST 与等量吸附热解释吸附结果，再用有文献依据的 Pareto/APS、APS×R%、CRITIC 与明确标记的历史 GasScore 模式排序。

methodWorkflow.label: Gas system classification
methodWorkflow.description: Group records by gas pair, target gas, and application context.
methodWorkflow.descriptionZh: 按气体对、目标气体和应用语境分组记录。

methodWorkflow.label: Condition-aware selectivity
methodWorkflow.description: Bind selectivity to feed ratio, temperature, pressure, method, and source.
methodWorkflow.descriptionZh: 将选择性绑定到气体比例、温度、压力、方法和来源。

methodWorkflow.label: Feed ratio-aware comparison
methodWorkflow.description: Warn when records mix feed ratios or methods.
methodWorkflow.descriptionZh: 当记录混合不同气体比例或方法时显示警告。

methodWorkflow.label: Thermodynamic interpretation
methodWorkflow.description: Use temperature-matched pure-component isotherms to distinguish low-pressure affinity, finite-pressure IAST competition, and isosteric heat.
methodWorkflow.descriptionZh: 使用同温纯组分等温线，区分低压亲和、有限压力 IAST 竞争与等量吸附热。

methodWorkflow.label: Method-backed ranking
methodWorkflow.description: Default to Pareto + APS without subjective weights, expose APS×R% and CRITIC alternatives, and retain GasScore only as a legacy heuristic.
methodWorkflow.descriptionZh: 默认使用无主观权重的 Pareto + APS，同时提供 APS×R% 与 CRITIC 替代视图，并仅把 GasScore 作为历史启发式保留。

methodWorkflow.label: Linked visualization
methodWorkflow.description: Use performance map, ranking bars, radar profile, and heatmap without fabricating curves.
methodWorkflow.descriptionZh: 使用性能图谱、排序条形图、雷达图和热力图，不伪造曲线。

visualizations.title: Interactive performance map
visualizations.description: x/y metrics, bubble size, and color are configurable; legend remains outside the plot area.
visualizations.descriptionZh: x/y 指标、气泡大小和颜色可切换；图例保留在绘图区外。

visualizations.title: Top candidates bar chart
visualizations.description: Shows Top 5 / Top 10 candidates by the selected method and links selection to the explanation panel.
visualizations.descriptionZh: 按当前选择的方法展示 Top 5 / Top 10 候选，并联动解释面板。

visualizations.title: Radar profile and heatmap
visualizations.description: Shows multi-metric candidate profiles without replacing missing values with zero.
visualizations.descriptionZh: 展示多指标画像，缺失值显示 pending，不用 0 冒充。

visualizations.title: Paired isotherm and thermodynamic interpretation
visualizations.titleZh: 双组分等温线与热力学解释
visualizations.description: Shows both pure-component curves when source points exist, binds scenario IAST to feed/temperature/pressure, and keeps Qst provenance visible.
visualizations.descriptionZh: 当来源点存在时同时显示两条纯组分曲线，把情景 IAST 绑定到进料比例、温度和压力，并显示 Qst 来源。

evidenceBoundary: Gas Adsorption Data Layer v1 records are structured seed fixtures for UI, schema, and field-provenance validation.
experimental, literature, simulation, predicted, rule-based, demo, and needs validation labels must not be treated as interchangeable evidence.
Legacy GasScore is a candidate-priority heuristic only; default ranking should prefer Pareto/APS, APS×R%, or CRITIC with method boundaries.
Isotherm fitting, Henry affinity, IAST, and Clausius-Clapeyron Qst are derived interpretations and must not be presented as primary mixture or breakthrough data.
All ranking modes must be followed by adsorption simulation, stability checks, experiments, and process assessment.
evidenceBoundaryZh: Gas Adsorption Data Layer v1 记录是用于界面、schema 和字段级溯源验证的结构化种子数据。
实验数据、文献数据、模拟数据、预测数据、规则推断、演示数据和待验证标签不能混作同等证据。
历史 GasScore 只是候选优先级启发式；默认排序应优先使用 Pareto/APS、APS×R% 或 CRITIC，并显示方法边界。
等温线拟合、Henry 亲和、IAST 与 Clausius-Clapeyron Qst 都是派生解释，不能呈现为原始混合气或穿透数据。
所有排序模式都必须接续吸附模拟、稳定性检查、实验验证和过程级评估。

methodGroups.title: Gas Adsorption Data Standard & Field Provenance
methodGroups.titleZh: 气体吸附数据标准与字段级溯源
methodGroups.purpose: Define the Gas Adsorption Data Layer v1 record contract, record-level provenance, field-level provenance, unit normalization, evidence labels, and demo-data boundaries used by GasSep.
methodGroups.purposeZh: 定义 GasSep 使用的 Gas Adsorption Data Layer v1 记录契约、记录级溯源、字段级溯源、单位规范化、证据标签和演示数据边界。

algorithmSteps.label: Load v1 records first
algorithmSteps.labelZh: 优先加载 v1 记录
algorithmSteps.description: GasSep loads public/data/gas_adsorption_records_v1.json before falling back to legacy demo records.
algorithmSteps.descriptionZh: GasSep 优先加载 public/data/gas_adsorption_records_v1.json，失败时才回退到旧 demo 记录。

algorithmSteps.label: Normalize display fields
algorithmSteps.description: Keep ASCII gas keys for filtering, but render CO2, CH4, N2, H2, and O2 with subscripts in visible UI.
algorithmSteps.descriptionZh: 筛选 key 保持 ASCII，但用户可见 UI 将 CO2、CH4、N2、H2、O2 渲染为下标格式。

algorithmSteps.label: Attach record provenance
algorithmSteps.description: Each record stores source database, source record id, version, citation, DOI/URL, license, retrieval date, curator, and curation note.
algorithmSteps.descriptionZh: 每条记录包含来源数据库、来源记录 ID、版本、引用、DOI/URL、许可、检索时间、整理者和整理说明。

algorithmSteps.label: Attach field provenance
algorithmSteps.description: Core metric and descriptor fields expose source type, citation, original value, normalized value, conversion note, curation status, and confidence.
algorithmSteps.descriptionZh: 核心指标和描述符字段暴露来源类型、引用、原始值、规范化值、换算说明、整理状态和置信度。

algorithmSteps.label: Separate evidence labels
algorithmSteps.description: Evidence levels A/B/C/D are separate from data type labels such as experimental, literature, simulation, predicted, rule-based, demo, and needs validation.
algorithmSteps.descriptionZh: 证据等级 A/B/C/D 与实验数据、文献数据、模拟数据、预测数据、规则推断、演示数据、待验证等数据类型标签分开显示。

algorithmSteps.label: Expose quality gaps
algorithmSteps.description: Quality panels show condition, unit, source, descriptor provenance, and validation gaps instead of hiding pending values.
algorithmSteps.descriptionZh: 质量面板展示工况、单位、来源、描述符溯源和验证缺口，不隐藏待补充值。

formulas.label: Unit normalization
formulas.explanation: Primary uptake, secondary uptake, and working capacity are normalized to mmol/g for UI comparison while raw values remain visible in provenance popovers.
formulas.explanationZh: 主气吸附量、副气吸附量和工作容量规范化为 mmol/g 用于 UI 比较，原始值保留在溯源弹窗中。

formulas.label: Evidence levels
formulas.fallback: A = experimental/high-quality literature; B = simulation/partial curation; C = predicted/inferred/incomplete; D = demo/placeholder
formulas.explanation: The evidence level is a boundary label and does not validate any ranking result by itself.
formulas.explanationZh: 证据等级是边界标签，本身不验证任何排序结果。

visualizations.title: Field provenance popover
visualizations.description: Every ranking metric can show source type, citation, raw value, normalized value, and conversion note.
visualizations.descriptionZh: 排序表中的核心指标可展示来源类型、引用、原始值、规范化值和换算说明。

visualizations.title: Record source and quality panels
visualizations.description: Selected candidates expose record-level source metadata and a quality checklist.
visualizations.descriptionZh: 选中候选展示记录级来源元数据和质量检查清单。

limitations: The v1 dataset is a structured seed fixture for UI and validation workflow testing, not a final scientific dataset.
Field provenance can describe source status, but it does not turn seed values into validated measurements.
Internal gasPair keys remain ASCII to avoid breaking filters and data routes.
limitationsZh: v1 数据集是用于 UI 与验证工作流测试的结构化种子数据，不是最终科研数据集。
字段级溯源可以说明来源状态，但不会把种子值变成已验证测量。
内部 gasPair key 保持 ASCII，避免破坏筛选和数据路线。

methodGroups.title: Condition-aware selectivity
methodGroups.purpose: Prevent selectivity values from being compared without gas system, feed ratio, temperature, pressure, method, and source.
methodGroups.purposeZh: 防止选择性在缺少气体体系、比例、温度、压力、方法和来源时被直接比较。

algorithmSteps.label: Create selectivity record
algorithmSteps.description: Store each value in selectivityRecords with condition fields.
algorithmSteps.descriptionZh: 将每个数值存入带条件字段的 selectivityRecords。

algorithmSteps.label: Attach field provenance
algorithmSteps.description: Attach source location and curation status to selectivity, feed ratio, method, and pressure.
algorithmSteps.descriptionZh: 为选择性、气体比例、方法和压力绑定来源位置和整理状态。

algorithmSteps.label: Compare by condition key
algorithmSteps.description: Only directly compare records with the same gas system, feed ratio, temperature, pressure, and method.
algorithmSteps.descriptionZh: 仅直接比较气体体系、比例、温度、压力和方法完全一致的记录。

formulas.label: Comparability rule
formulas.fallback: Comparable = same(gasSystem, feedRatio, T, P, method)
formulas.explanation: Direct ranking is allowed only when the full condition key matches.
formulas.explanationZh: 只有完整条件键一致时才允许直接排名。

formulas.label: Source-reported selectivity
formulas.explanation: The source definition and condition key are retained; the interface does not silently replace it with another selectivity principle.
formulas.explanationZh: 保留来源定义与工况键；界面不会静默换成另一种选择性原理。

formulas.label: Source-reported IAST
formulas.fallback: S_A/B^IAST,(r) = source-reported IAST at record conditions
formulas.explanation: A source-labelled IAST value is not recomputed unless the paired raw isotherms are available.
formulas.explanationZh: 来源标记的 IAST 只有在成对原始等温线可用时才重新计算。

formulas.label: Single-point uptake-ratio proxy
formulas.explanation: This proxy is used only when the source explicitly defines a same-condition uptake ratio; it is not IAST.
formulas.explanationZh: 仅当来源明确给出同工况吸附量比时使用该代理；它不是 IAST。

formulas.label: Model-predicted selectivity
formulas.fallback: predicted S_A/B = f_theta(material descriptors, record conditions)
formulas.explanation: Predicted selectivity is identified as a model output and is not displayed as a thermodynamic equation or measurement.
formulas.explanationZh: 预测选择性明确标记为模型输出，不显示成热力学方程或测量值。

outputsZh: 可直接比较 / 条件混合状态

visualizations.title: Condition-aware comparison panel
visualizations.description: Shows each selectivity value with condition tags and provenance.
visualizations.descriptionZh: 为每个选择性值显示条件标签和来源。

limitations: Different feed ratios, temperatures, pressures, or methods cannot be mixed as strict rankings.
limitationsZh: 不同气体比例、温度、压力或方法的数据不能混合作为严格排名。

methodGroups.title: Adsorption thermodynamic interpretation
methodGroups.purpose: Explain why a selected material shows its current adsorption result without turning fitted or derived quantities into primary measurements.
methodGroups.purposeZh: 解释选中材料为何出现当前吸附结果，同时避免把拟合量或派生量写成原始测量。

algorithmSteps.label: Resolve paired pure-component isotherms
algorithmSteps.labelZh: 解析成对纯组分等温线
algorithmSteps.description: Match the primary and secondary gas by material identity, source isotherm id, publication DOI, and temperature. Plot both curves only when source points are available.
algorithmSteps.descriptionZh: 按材料实体、来源等温线 ID、论文 DOI 与温度匹配主气和副气；只有来源点存在时才绘制两条曲线。

algorithmSteps.label: Estimate low-pressure affinity
algorithmSteps.description: Fit each pure-component isotherm and calculate the zero-pressure slope only for models with a finite Henry limit.
algorithmSteps.descriptionZh: 分别拟合纯组分等温线，并且只对具有有限 Henry 极限的模型计算零压斜率。

algorithmSteps.label: Recalculate scenario IAST
algorithmSteps.description: Recalculate binary IAST only when both isotherms are temperature-matched, the mixture ratio is valid, the selected total pressure lies within their shared support, and the solved fictive pure-component pressures do not exceed the source-curve maxima.
algorithmSteps.descriptionZh: 仅在两条等温线同温、混合比例有效、所选总压位于共同数据范围内，且求解得到的虚拟纯组分压力不超过来源曲线最高压力时重算二元 IAST。

algorithmSteps.label: Use source or same-publication Qst
algorithmSteps.labelZh: 使用来源或同文献 Qst
algorithmSteps.description: Prefer a source-reported heat of adsorption. Otherwise require at least three temperatures for the same material, gas, and DOI, then regress ln(P) against 1/T at one overlapping loading.
algorithmSteps.descriptionZh: 优先使用来源报告的吸附热；否则要求同一材料、气体和 DOI 至少有三个温度，再在共同吸附量下回归 ln(P) 与 1/T。

algorithmSteps.label: Separate equilibrium from process validation
algorithmSteps.labelZh: 区分平衡解释与过程验证
algorithmSteps.description: Use Henry and IAST to explain equilibrium affinity and competition, but require breakthrough, humidity, and cycling data for process claims.
algorithmSteps.descriptionZh: 用 Henry 与 IAST 解释平衡亲和和竞争，但过程结论仍需要穿透、湿度和循环数据。

formulas.label: Henry affinity
formulas.explanation: The zero-pressure slope is a fitted low-pressure affinity indicator. It is not a mixture selectivity measurement.
formulas.explanationZh: 零压斜率是拟合得到的低压亲和指标，不是混合气选择性测量。

formulas.label: Henry affinity ratio
formulas.explanation: The ratio compares zero-pressure affinity and must remain separate from finite-pressure IAST selectivity.
formulas.explanationZh: 该比值比较零压亲和，必须与有限压力 IAST 选择性分开。

formulas.label: Scenario IAST selectivity
formulas.explanation: x is the adsorbed-phase fraction and y is the gas-phase fraction at the selected total pressure and feed composition.
formulas.explanationZh: x 为吸附相摩尔分数，y 为所选总压和进料组成下的气相摩尔分数。

formulas.label: Binary IAST equilibrium constraints
formulas.labelZh: 二元 IAST 平衡约束
formulas.fallback: y_i P = x_i P_i^0; pi_A(P_A^0) = pi_B(P_B^0); sum(x_i) = 1
formulas.explanation: The fictive pure-component pressures are solved from spreading-pressure equality. A scenario result is withheld when either solved pressure exceeds the corresponding source-curve maximum.
formulas.explanationZh: 虚拟纯组分压力由铺展压力相等条件求解；当任一求解压力超过相应来源曲线最高压力时，不输出该情景的 IAST 数值。

formulas.label: Isosteric heat from an isostere
formulas.labelZh: 由等量吸附线计算等量吸附热
formulas.fallback: Qst ≈ -R * d(ln P) / d(1/T) at fixed q
formulas.explanation: The implementation uses pressure under an ideal-gas approximation and requires a common loading interval across at least three same-publication temperatures.
formulas.explanationZh: 当前实现采用理想气体近似下的压力，并要求同一文献至少三个温度在吸附量上存在共同区间。

inputsZh: 主气与副气纯组分等温线
outputsZh: 情景 IAST 或不可用原因

visualizations.title: Paired pure-component isotherms
visualizations.description: Shows both gases at the source temperature and marks the selected scenario pressure without fabricating missing curves.
visualizations.descriptionZh: 在来源温度下同时显示两种气体并标记情景压力，不补造缺失曲线。

references.label: NIST Guidelines for Reporting of Adsorption Data
references.note: Reporting guidance for isotherms, fitted models, isosteric heat, and thermodynamic quantities.
references.noteZh: 等温线、拟合模型、等量吸附热与热力学量的报告规范。

references.label: NIST Data Resources for Adsorption
references.note: Primary data infrastructure for indexed isotherms, thermodynamic conditions, fitting, and IAST workflows.
references.noteZh: 按材料、吸附质和热力学条件索引等温线，并支持拟合与 IAST 工作流的数据基础设施。

references.label: Myers & Prausnitz 1965 — IAST
references.note: Foundational ideal adsorbed solution theory for predicting mixture adsorption from pure-component isotherms.
references.noteZh: 由纯组分等温线预测混合吸附的理想吸附溶液理论基础。

references.label: Simon, Smit & Haranczyk 2016 — pyIAST
references.note: Reproducible implementation and practical model-fitting context for IAST.
references.noteZh: IAST 的可复现实现与实际等温线拟合说明。

references.label: Li et al. 2019 — FJU-90a C2H2/CO2
references.note: Relevant to the PPT example: equimolar C2H2/CO2 at 298 K and 1 bar, with selectivity and uptake interpreted together.
references.noteZh: 对应 PPT 中的等摩尔 C₂H₂/CO₂ 示例：298 K、1 bar，并同时解释选择性与吸附量。

references.label: Nature Communications 2020 — trace C2H2/C2H4 separation
references.note: Supports trace-feed scenarios, paired isotherms, Qst, IAST, breakthrough, and cycling as distinct evidence layers.
references.noteZh: 支持痕量进料情景，并将双等温线、Qst、IAST、穿透与循环作为不同证据层。

limitations: Fitted models and derived thermodynamic quantities are not primary adsorption data.
Henry affinity is a zero-pressure indicator and is not interchangeable with finite-pressure IAST or breakthrough selectivity.
Scenario IAST is unavailable when the second isotherm, temperature match, valid feed ratio, shared total-pressure range, or fitted pure-component pressure support is missing.
Qst is not derived from one isotherm or by mixing publications; a source value or at least three same-publication temperatures is required.
IAST assumes an ideal adsorbed solution and does not establish mass-transfer, humidity, cycling, or process performance.
limitationsZh: 拟合模型与派生热力学量不是原始吸附数据。
Henry 亲和是零压指标，不能与有限压力 IAST 或穿透选择性互换。
当缺少副气等温线、温度匹配、有效进料比例、共同总压范围，或 IAST 反算纯组分压力超出来源曲线上限时，不计算情景 IAST。
不从单条等温线推导 Qst，也不混合不同文献；必须有来源值或同一文献至少三个温度。
IAST 假设理想吸附溶液，不能证明传质、湿度、循环或过程性能。

methodGroups.title: Method-backed gas candidate ranking
methodGroups.titleZh: 有方法依据的气体分离候选排序
methodGroups.purpose: Rank gas-separation candidates for a selected gas pair and operating condition without treating subjective weights as literature-authoritative.
methodGroups.purposeZh: 在选定气体对和工况下排序气体分离候选，同时避免把主观权重当作文献权威。

algorithmSteps.label: Build data eligibility gates
algorithmSteps.description: Count records with selectivity, working capacity, APS, APS×R%, Pareto-frontier status, and validation-ready evidence.
algorithmSteps.descriptionZh: 统计具备选择性、工作容量、APS、APS×R%、Pareto 前沿状态和验证优先证据的记录。

algorithmSteps.label: Default Pareto + APS ranking
algorithmSteps.labelZh: 默认 Pareto + APS 排序
algorithmSteps.description: Use the non-dominated frontier over selectivity and working capacity; use APS = selectivity × working capacity as a transparent tie-breaker.
algorithmSteps.descriptionZh: 在选择性与工作容量维度上计算非支配前沿，并用 APS = 选择性 × 工作容量作为透明的同前沿排序依据。

algorithmSteps.label: APS × R% alternative
algorithmSteps.description: Combine APS with percent regenerability directly, without adding a subjective weight vector.
algorithmSteps.descriptionZh: 直接把 APS 与可再生性相乘，不额外加入主观权重向量。

algorithmSteps.label: CRITIC objective-weight alternative
algorithmSteps.labelZh: CRITIC 客观赋权替代视图
algorithmSteps.description: Calculate weights from metric contrast intensity and conflict in the current candidate matrix.
algorithmSteps.descriptionZh: 从当前候选矩阵中按指标区分度与冲突度计算客观权重。

algorithmSteps.label: Keep legacy GasScore separate
algorithmSteps.description: Keep GasScore contribution and risk-penalty panels for continuity, but label them as historical heuristic diagnostics.
algorithmSteps.descriptionZh: 为连续性保留 GasScore 贡献和风险扣分面板，但明确标注为历史启发式诊断。

formulas.label: Adsorbent performance score
formulas.explanation: APS combines selectivity and useful loading swing, both of which are commonly reported in high-throughput adsorbent screening.
formulas.explanationZh: APS 将选择性与可用装载差结合，是高通量吸附剂筛选中常用的材料级指标。

formulas.label: APS × regenerability
formulas.explanation: This mode keeps regenerability visible without inventing a subjective weight vector.
formulas.explanationZh: 该模式在不发明主观权重向量的前提下保持可再生性可见。

formulas.label: CRITIC objective weight
formulas.fallback: Cj = sigma_j * sum(1-r_jk); wj = Cj / sum(Cj)
formulas.explanation: CRITIC weights are derived from the current candidate matrix and should not be generalized outside that matrix.
formulas.explanationZh: CRITIC 权重由当前候选矩阵派生，不应外推到该矩阵之外。

formulas.label: Legacy GasScore
formulas.explanation: This is retained only for continuity and diagnostic comparison; the weights are not literature-authoritative.
formulas.explanationZh: 该分数仅为连续性和诊断对照保留；其权重不是文献权威。

visualizations.title: Method-aware ranking table
visualizations.description: Table sorting, method score, APS, and legacy GasScore remain visible but separate.
visualizations.descriptionZh: 表格同时显示当前方法指标、APS 与历史 GasScore，并保持三者分离。

limitations: Default ranking avoids subjective weights but still depends on available fields and comparable conditions.
Legacy GasScore is a screening priority heuristic, not a validated separation performance.
Demo records intentionally expose data boundaries and should be replaced by curated literature or experimental records before scientific use.
limitationsZh: 默认排序避免主观权重，但仍依赖字段覆盖与工况可比性。
历史 GasScore 是筛选优先级启发式，不是验证后的分离性能。
Demo 记录刻意暴露数据边界，科研使用前应替换为整理后的文献或实验记录。

methodGroups.title: Gas Separation Ranking & Validation Method
methodGroups.titleZh: 气体分离排序与验证方法
methodGroups.purpose: Explain how GasSep turns condition-bound adsorption records into method-specific shortlists and validation recommendations without treating screening metrics as process proof.
methodGroups.purposeZh: 说明 GasSep 如何把绑定工况的吸附记录转化为方法特异短名单和验证建议，同时避免把筛选指标当作过程级证明。

algorithmSteps.label: Scenario-aware screening
algorithmSteps.description: Filter by gas pair, feed ratio, temperature, pressure, and ranking method before comparing candidates.
algorithmSteps.descriptionZh: 先按气体对、进料比例、温度、压力和排序方法筛选，再比较候选。

algorithmSteps.label: Method selection before scoring
algorithmSteps.description: Choose Pareto + APS, APS×R%, CRITIC, or legacy GasScore before interpreting a first-ranked candidate.
algorithmSteps.descriptionZh: 在解释第一名候选前，先明确使用 Pareto + APS、APS×R%、CRITIC 还是历史 GasScore。

algorithmSteps.label: Working capacity
algorithmSteps.description: Prefer candidates with useful loading swing between adsorption and desorption conditions instead of maximum uptake alone.
algorithmSteps.descriptionZh: 优先考虑吸附 / 脱附条件之间有实际装载差的候选，而不是只看最大吸附量。

algorithmSteps.label: Regenerability proxy
algorithmSteps.description: Use regenerability and heat-of-adsorption signals as a screening proxy for cyclic operation burden.
algorithmSteps.descriptionZh: 用可再生性和吸附热信号作为循环运行负担的筛选 proxy。

algorithmSteps.label: Selectivity methods
algorithmSteps.description: Keep IAST, simulated, predicted, and experimental-style selectivity separate unless conditions and methods match.
algorithmSteps.descriptionZh: 除非条件和方法匹配，否则分开看 IAST、模拟、预测和实验风格选择性。

algorithmSteps.label: Cross-method stability
algorithmSteps.description: Compare Top candidates across methods and treat recurring candidates as stronger validation-shortlist entries.
algorithmSteps.descriptionZh: 比较不同方法下的 Top 候选，把跨方法反复出现的候选作为更强的验证短名单对象。

algorithmSteps.label: Validation roadmap
algorithmSteps.description: Map each selected candidate to GCMC, IAST, water stability, regeneration cycling, breakthrough, or process-level assessment.
algorithmSteps.descriptionZh: 把每个选中候选连接到 GCMC、IAST、水稳定性、再生循环、穿透实验或过程级评估。

formulas.label: Pareto frontier
formulas.latex: \nexists j:\ C_{w,j}\ge C_{w,i},\ S_j\ge S_i,\ \mathrm{and}\ (C_{w,j}>C_{w,i}\ \mathrm{or}\ S_j>S_i)
formulas.fallback: No other candidate has both >= working capacity and >= selectivity, with one strictly better.
formulas.explanation: A Pareto-frontier candidate is not dominated by another record in the selectivity and working-capacity plane.
formulas.explanationZh: Pareto 前沿候选在选择性与工作容量平面上没有被另一条记录同时压制。

formulas.label: Working capacity
formulas.explanation: Working capacity is the same-gas, same-temperature loading swing over the selected pressure window, not total storage capacity.
formulas.explanationZh: 工作容量是同一气体、同一温度下在所选压力窗口内的装载差，不是总储量。

formulas.label: Regenerability proxy
formulas.explanation: The implementation derives regenerability from the same isotherm and pressure window. Qst is interpreted separately as an energetic burden signal and is not multiplied into R.
formulas.explanationZh: 当前实现由同一等温线和压力窗口计算可再生性；Qst 作为能量负担信号单独解释，不乘入 R。

formulas.label: IAST selectivity
formulas.explanation: IAST requires comparable single-component isotherms and explicit gas composition.
formulas.explanationZh: IAST 需要可比的单组分等温线和明确气体组成。

formulas.label: Evidence gate
formulas.fallback: Evidence gate = A/B evidence OR confidence >= 0.72 OR experimental/computed grade
formulas.explanation: The evidence gate is a visibility/filtering rule, not a proof that the material works.
formulas.explanationZh: 证据门控只是可见性和筛选规则，不证明材料真实可用。

visualizations.title: Interactive Top ranking
visualizations.description: Top 5 / Top 10 bars follow the current ranking method; contribution mode is explicitly legacy GasScore.
visualizations.descriptionZh: Top 5 / Top 10 条形图跟随当前排序方法；贡献拆解模式明确为历史 GasScore。

visualizations.title: Radar profile comparison
visualizations.description: Selected or compared MOFs are shown by normalized uptake, selectivity, working capacity, regenerability, stability, and evidence.
visualizations.descriptionZh: 按归一化吸附量、选择性、工作容量、可再生性、稳定性和证据展示选中或对比 MOF。

visualizations.title: Diagnostic heatmap
visualizations.description: Normalized, raw, and legacy-contribution views expose which metric drives or limits a candidate.
visualizations.descriptionZh: normalized、raw 和历史贡献视图显示哪些指标驱动或限制候选。

limitations: Pareto/APS and APS×R% are material screening metrics, not process-optimized performance.
CRITIC weights describe information in the current candidate set, not universal chemical importance.
Legacy GasScore is a screening priority score, not measured separation performance.
Demo, predicted, simulated, and experimental-template records are not interchangeable evidence levels.
Heatmap and radar values are scenario-normalized diagnostics, not universal material rankings.
limitationsZh: Pareto/APS 与 APS×R% 是材料筛选指标，不是过程优化性能。
CRITIC 权重描述当前候选集的信息量，不是普适化学重要性。
历史 GasScore 是筛选优先级分数，不是实测分离性能。
演示数据、预测数据、模拟数据和实验风格模板记录不是可互换的证据等级。
热力图和雷达图数值是场景归一化诊断，不是通用材料排名。

methodGroups.title: Gas separation visual analytics
methodGroups.purpose: Show how selectivity changes with pressure and how target uptake relates to selectivity under explicit conditions.
methodGroups.purposeZh: 在明确条件下展示选择性随压力变化，以及目标气吸附量与选择性的关系。

algorithmSteps.label: Build pressure series
algorithmSteps.description: Group records by MOF and condition metadata; do not interpolate missing values.
algorithmSteps.descriptionZh: 按 MOF 和条件元数据分组，不插值缺失数值。

algorithmSteps.label: Build uptake-selectivity points
algorithmSteps.description: Match target-gas uptake records to selectivity records by temperature and pressure.
algorithmSteps.descriptionZh: 按温度和压力将目标气吸附记录与选择性记录匹配。

algorithmSteps.label: Encode evidence level
algorithmSteps.description: Use color or badge to distinguish reviewed, pending, and source-pending values.
algorithmSteps.descriptionZh: 用颜色或标签区分 reviewed、pending 和 source-pending。

visualizations.title: Pressure and uptake charts
visualizations.description: Chart titles and tooltips include gas system, feed ratio, T, P, method, and source location.
visualizations.descriptionZh: 图标题和 tooltip 包含气体体系、比例、温度、压力、方法和来源位置。

limitations: A single point is displayed as a single point; the interface does not fabricate a curve.
limitationsZh: 单点数据只显示为单点，界面不伪造曲线。

summary: Catalysis organizes catalytic pathway evidence, reaction fingerprints, MOF rationale, and validation needs while keeping hypotheses separate from proof.
summaryZh: 催化模块整理催化路径证据、反应指纹、MOF 依据和验证需求，同时区分假设与证明。

methodWorkflow.label: Pathway evidence map
methodWorkflow.description: Place catalytic records in a pathway-by-evidence landscape.
methodWorkflow.descriptionZh: 将催化记录放入路径-证据空间。

methodWorkflow.label: Reaction pathway classification
methodWorkflow.description: Separate product classes, mechanism hints, and validation status.
methodWorkflow.descriptionZh: 区分产物类别、机理线索和验证状态。

methodWorkflow.label: Reaction fingerprint
methodWorkflow.description: Summarize pathway features, candidate rationale, and evidence coverage.
methodWorkflow.descriptionZh: 汇总路径特征、候选依据和证据覆盖。

methodWorkflow.label: Validation roadmap
methodWorkflow.description: Translate evidence gaps into next experiments or DFT tasks.
methodWorkflow.descriptionZh: 将证据缺口转换为后续实验或 DFT 任务。

visualizations.title: Catalytic pathway evidence map
visualizations.description: Scatter-style map for performance potential, evidence readiness, and data coverage.
visualizations.descriptionZh: 用散点图表达性能潜力、证据成熟度和数据覆盖度。

evidenceBoundary: Organic acid conversion is a prioritized sub-workspace within Catalysis, not the full scope of the module.
Pathway evidence maps organize hypotheses and literature signals; they do not establish mechanism by themselves.
evidenceBoundaryZh: 有机酸转化是催化中优先展示的子工作台，但不是催化模块的全部范围。
路径证据图组织假设和文献信号，本身不证明机理。
validationRoadmap: separate measured yields from rule-derived hypotheses
validationRoadmapZh: 区分实测产率与规则派生假设

methodGroups.title: Catalytic pathway evidence map
methodGroups.purpose: Compare pathway records by evidence readiness, data coverage, and validation status.
methodGroups.purposeZh: 按证据成熟度、数据覆盖度和验证状态比较路径记录。

algorithmSteps.label: Classify pathway
algorithmSteps.description: Assign reaction records to product and pathway categories.
algorithmSteps.descriptionZh: 将反应记录分配到产物和路径类别。

algorithmSteps.label: Score evidence readiness
algorithmSteps.description: Combine literature, measured, rule-based, and pending status.
algorithmSteps.descriptionZh: 组合文献、实测、规则和 pending 状态。

algorithmSteps.label: Expose validation needs
algorithmSteps.description: Show which experiments or simulations are still needed.
algorithmSteps.descriptionZh: 展示仍需哪些实验或模拟。

visualizations.title: Evidence map
visualizations.description: Scatter chart of performance potential and evidence readiness.
visualizations.descriptionZh: 性能潜力与证据成熟度散点图。

limitations: The map supports prioritization, not proof of catalytic activity.
limitationsZh: 该图支持优先级判断，不证明催化活性。

summary: The current V3.9.10 method is a deterministic, abundance-neutral host–guest pathway screen with eight locked factors, explicit provenance, audit artifacts, and validation boundaries.
summaryZh: 当前 V3.9.10 方法是丰度中性的主客体路径白盒筛选：八因子与权重预先锁定，来源、审计产物和验证边界全部显式展示。
specialNote: Only the current preregistered V3.9.10 terms are shown. Earlier composite-tier terminology and superseded proxy formulas are excluded.
specialNoteZh: 本页只展示当前预登记的 V3.9.10 术语；早期综合分层称谓和已被替换的代理公式不再显示。

methodWorkflow.label: Load governed source layers
methodWorkflow.description: Load CoRE structural/stability fields, FAIR-MOFs synthesis conditions, literature and gold evidence, and transparent economics inputs.
methodWorkflow.descriptionZh: 读取 CoRE 结构与稳定性字段、FAIR‑MOFs 合成条件、文献与金标准证据，以及透明经济性输入。

methodWorkflow.label: Resolve identity and conditions
methodWorkflow.description: Link structures only by exact or base CSD Refcodes and keep same-DOI records separate unless a structure identifier also matches.
methodWorkflow.descriptionZh: 结构连接只接受精确或基础 CSD Refcode；仅 DOI 相同而结构标识不一致的记录保持独立。

methodWorkflow.label: Apply abundance-neutral derivation
methodWorkflow.description: Use counts for empirical-Bayes shrinkage and confidence only; never reward a family simply because it has more rows.
methodWorkflow.descriptionZh: 记录数量只用于经验贝叶斯收缩和置信度，不因某家族条目更多而提高材料得分。

methodWorkflow.label: Compute eight-factor HGCPS
methodWorkflow.description: Aggregate fixed 0–1 factors with preregistered weights and a weighted geometric mean.
methodWorkflow.descriptionZh: 以预先登记的固定权重，将八个 0–1 因子按加权几何平均聚合。

methodWorkflow.label: Audit and expose gaps
methodWorkflow.description: Run invariance, mutation, ablation, sensitivity, and small-sample audits and retain fallback/missing reasons.
methodWorkflow.descriptionZh: 执行不变性、规则变更、消融、敏感性和小样本审计，并保留 fallback／缺失原因。

inputsZh: CoRE 稳定性与结构描述符
outputsZh: 逐因子派生层级与引用
敏感性与丰度偏差审计

visualizations.title: Eight-factor method profile
visualizations.description: Artifact-derived factors, locked weights, source roles, and fallback states.
visualizations.descriptionZh: 从生成产物读取因子、锁定权重、来源职责和 fallback 状态。

visualizations.title: Interactive sensitivity explanation
visualizations.description: A non-persistent explanatory control shows how a factor direction changes the geometric aggregate.
visualizations.descriptionZh: 不写回正式结果的演示控件，用于理解单因子方向如何影响几何聚合。

evidenceBoundary: HGCPS prioritizes validation; it is not measured catalytic yield, selectivity, conversion, or lifetime.
FAIR-MOFs condition accessibility is not a synthesis-success probability.
Family-level correlation audits are indicative because sample size and statistical power remain low.
Fallback factors stay visible and cannot be presented as source-measured properties.
evidenceBoundaryZh: HGCPS 用于安排验证优先级，不是实测产率、选择性、转化率或寿命。
FAIR‑MOFs 条件可达性不是合成成功概率。
家族级相关性审计样本量与统计功效较低，只能作为提示。
fallback 因子必须保持可见，不能表述为来源实测性质。
validationRoadmap: Add route-specific synthesis failures and yields
verify guest-metal factors experimentally or by dedicated DFT
rerun locked scoring and publish audit deltas
validationRoadmapZh: 补充路线特异的合成失败记录与产率
收集条件匹配的催化对照
用专门实验或 DFT 核验客体金属因子
按锁定规则重跑并公开审计差异

implementationLogic.process: Exact/base Refcode match; DOI remains article-level only
implementationLogic.output: structure link or explicit unmapped state
implementationLogic.guard: No fuzzy-name or DOI-only structure merge

implementationLogic.process: empirical-Bayes shrinkage toward descriptor-specific global prior
implementationLogic.guard: duplicating identical rows cannot improve the point score

implementationLogic.process: locked weighted geometric mean with 0.001 numerical floor
implementationLogic.guard: weights sum to one; scoring spec mutation fails audit

implementationLogic.process: read generated artifact provenance and audit state
implementationLogic.output: factor values, sources, n, citations, fallback reasons
implementationLogic.guard: never label the result as measured catalytic performance

methodGroups.title: Identity, source, and condition governance
methodGroups.purpose: Prevent cross-material contamination before any factor is derived.
methodGroups.purposeZh: 在派生任何因子前阻止跨材料污染。

algorithmSteps.label: Read source registry
algorithmSteps.description: Load source version, licence, record ids, checksums, and retrieval date.
algorithmSteps.descriptionZh: 读取来源版本、许可、记录 ID、校验和与检索日期。

algorithmSteps.label: Resolve structure identity
algorithmSteps.description: Use exact/base CSD Refcode; keep DOI associations at article level.
algorithmSteps.descriptionZh: 使用精确／基础 CSD Refcode；DOI 关联只停留在文章层。

algorithmSteps.label: Preserve conditions
algorithmSteps.description: Retain temperature, time, solvent, adsorbate, and measurement context.
algorithmSteps.descriptionZh: 保留温度、时间、溶剂、吸附质和测量语境。

algorithmSteps.label: Mark gaps
algorithmSteps.description: Record null, fallback, unmapped, or insufficient-n rather than filling a proxy silently.
algorithmSteps.descriptionZh: 以 null、fallback、未映射或样本不足明确记录，不静默补代理值。

limitations: A source association does not prove that records describe the same structure or experimental condition.
limitationsZh: 来源关联不等于记录描述同一结构或同一实验条件。

methodGroups.title: Abundance-neutral factor derivation
methodGroups.purpose: Separate evidence maturity from the material point score.
methodGroups.purposeZh: 将证据成熟度与材料点估计得分严格分离。

algorithmSteps.label: Aggregate source properties
algorithmSteps.description: Use family medians for relevant source fields.
algorithmSteps.descriptionZh: 对相关来源字段使用家族中位数。

algorithmSteps.label: Shrink to prior
algorithmSteps.description: Apply descriptor-specific empirical-Bayes shrinkage.
algorithmSteps.descriptionZh: 按描述符执行经验贝叶斯收缩。

algorithmSteps.label: Report confidence
algorithmSteps.description: Counts affect confidence and uncertainty only.
algorithmSteps.descriptionZh: 记录数量只影响置信度和不确定性。

algorithmSteps.label: Test invariance
algorithmSteps.description: Duplicate identical rows and require no score improvement.
algorithmSteps.descriptionZh: 复制相同行并要求得分不得提高。

formulas.label: Empirical-Bayes shrinkage
formulas.fallback: x_tilde = λ median(x) + (1-λ) μ0; λ = n_eff/(n_eff+k)
formulas.explanation: Counts control shrinkage strength, never a direct score bonus.
formulas.explanationZh: 记录数量只控制收缩强度，不直接奖励得分。

limitations: Sparse families remain close to the prior and must not be read as precisely characterized.
limitationsZh: 稀疏家族会保持接近先验，不能解读为已被精确表征。

methodGroups.title: Locked eight-factor HGCPS
methodGroups.purpose: Combine complementary host, guest, evidence, risk, synthesis, and economics factors without hiding bottlenecks.
methodGroups.purposeZh: 组合主体、客体、证据、风险、合成与经济性因子，同时保留瓶颈。

algorithmSteps.label: Normalize factors
algorithmSteps.description: Use fixed physical bounds, shrinkage, or explicitly declared curated tiers.
algorithmSteps.descriptionZh: 使用固定物理边界、收缩或明确登记的整理档位。

algorithmSteps.label: Apply locked weights
algorithmSteps.description: Read all eight weights from scoring spec v3.
algorithmSteps.descriptionZh: 从评分规范 v3 读取八个锁定权重。

algorithmSteps.label: Geometric aggregation
algorithmSteps.description: Apply a 0.001 numerical floor and weighted product.
algorithmSteps.descriptionZh: 应用 0.001 数值下限并计算加权乘积。

algorithmSteps.label: Emit trace
algorithmSteps.description: Store factor value, derivation level, n, refs, citations, and fallback reason.
algorithmSteps.descriptionZh: 保存因子值、派生层级、n、记录、引用和 fallback 原因。

formulas.label: Final HGCPS
formulas.explanation: The weighted geometric mean keeps a weak factor visible as a bottleneck.
formulas.explanationZh: 加权几何平均使弱因子持续作为瓶颈可见。

limitations: The route ordering is a validation-planning output, not a measured catalytic ranking.
limitationsZh: 路线排序是验证规划输出，不是实测催化排名。

methodGroups.title: Audit, sensitivity, and falsification
methodGroups.purpose: Show where the current result is stable, fragile, fallback-driven, or statistically underpowered.
methodGroups.purposeZh: 展示当前结果在哪些方面稳定、脆弱、由 fallback 驱动或统计功效不足。

algorithmSteps.label: Rule mutation audit
algorithmSteps.description: Compare the runtime scoring spec to the locked artifact.
algorithmSteps.descriptionZh: 对比运行时评分规范与锁定产物。

algorithmSteps.label: Descriptor ablation
algorithmSteps.description: Remove one factor at a time and recompute route movement.
algorithmSteps.descriptionZh: 每次移除一个因子并重算路线变化。

algorithmSteps.label: Ranking sensitivity
algorithmSteps.description: Perturb eligible parameters within declared bounds.
algorithmSteps.descriptionZh: 在声明边界内扰动合格参数。

algorithmSteps.label: Validation queue
algorithmSteps.description: Prioritize missing fields and experiments that could change decisions.
algorithmSteps.descriptionZh: 优先补充可能改变决策的缺失字段与实验。

limitations: Passing software audits does not validate chemical causality or experimental reproducibility.
limitationsZh: 软件审计通过不等于化学因果或实验可重复性已验证。

summary: MOF Library provides descriptor curation status, name resolution, source-linked data records, and field-level provenance.
summaryZh: MOF库提供描述符整理状态、名称解析、来源关联数据记录和字段级来源。

methodWorkflow.label: Name resolution
methodWorkflow.description: Separate common display names, aliases, and source-linked records.
methodWorkflow.descriptionZh: 区分常用显示名、别名和来源关联记录。

methodWorkflow.label: Descriptor curation checklist
methodWorkflow.description: Track the eight core descriptors and their data status.
methodWorkflow.descriptionZh: 追踪 8 个核心描述符及其数据状态。

methodWorkflow.label: Field-level provenance
methodWorkflow.description: Attach source, location, and curation status to each important field.
methodWorkflow.descriptionZh: 为每个重要字段绑定来源、位置和整理状态。

visualizations.title: Descriptor coverage card
visualizations.description: Shows curated core descriptors and pending fields.
visualizations.descriptionZh: 展示已整理核心描述符和待补字段。

evidenceBoundary: Library records are source-linked data records, not scientific conclusions by themselves.
Name resolution status must remain visible when aliases or identifiers are uncertain.
evidenceBoundaryZh: 候选库记录是来源关联数据记录，本身不是科研结论。
当别名或标识符不确定时，必须显示名称解析状态。
validationRoadmapZh: 补充 DOI 和图/表位置
整理核心描述符覆盖度
跨模块评分前解析别名

methodGroups.title: Descriptor Curation Checklist
methodGroups.purpose: Keep eight core descriptor fields visible and separate available, pending, estimated, and missing values.
methodGroups.purposeZh: 保持 8 个核心描述符字段可见，并区分 available、pending、estimated 和 missing。

algorithmSteps.label: Check eight descriptors
algorithmSteps.description: surfaceArea, poreSizeA, poreVolume, co2Uptake, bandGap, waterStability, thermalStability, toxicityConcern.
algorithmSteps.descriptionZh: surfaceArea、poreSizeA、poreVolume、co2Uptake、bandGap、waterStability、thermalStability、toxicityConcern。

algorithmSteps.label: Assign status badge
algorithmSteps.description: Mark reviewed, pending, estimated, or missing.
algorithmSteps.descriptionZh: 标记 reviewed、pending、estimated 或 missing。

algorithmSteps.label: Attach source-linked record
algorithmSteps.description: Connect field values to paper, database, figure, table, or section when known.
algorithmSteps.descriptionZh: 在已知时将字段值连接到论文、数据库、图、表或章节。

visualizations.title: Descriptor coverage
visualizations.description: X/8 descriptors curated with field status badges.
visualizations.descriptionZh: 以字段状态标签显示 X/8 描述符已整理。

limitations: Missing descriptors must stay visible and should not be silently imputed in user-facing claims.
limitationsZh: 缺失描述符必须保持可见，不应在用户可见结论中静默填补。

summary: Shared evidence methods define field-level provenance, evidence levels, curation status, source location, and comparison warnings across modules.
summaryZh: 共享证据方法定义跨模块的字段级来源、证据等级、整理状态、来源位置和比较警告。

methodWorkflow.label: Field-level provenance
methodWorkflow.description: Record source, source location, evidence type, and curation status for important values.
methodWorkflow.descriptionZh: 为重要数值记录来源、来源位置、证据类型和整理状态。

methodWorkflow.label: Evidence levels
methodWorkflow.description: Distinguish reviewed, pending, estimated, missing, literature-derived, and experiment-roadmap records.
methodWorkflow.descriptionZh: 区分 reviewed、pending、estimated、missing、literature-derived 和 experiment-roadmap 记录。

methodWorkflow.label: Comparison warning
methodWorkflow.description: Warn when values are not comparable because conditions, evidence, or methods differ.
methodWorkflow.descriptionZh: 当条件、证据或方法不同导致不可比时显示警告。

inputsZh: 作者 / 期刊 / 年份

visualizations.title: Evidence boundary badges
visualizations.description: Reviewed, pending, estimated, missing, demonstration, seed, and curated literature statuses remain visible.
visualizations.descriptionZh: reviewed、pending、estimated、missing、demonstration、seed 和 curated literature 状态保持可见。

evidenceBoundary: Demonstration, seed dataset, curated literature, and reviewed record are not interchangeable.
DOI, figure, table, and section locations should be shown when available.
evidenceBoundaryZh: demonstration、seed dataset、curated literature 和 reviewed record 不能互换。
可用时应显示 DOI、图、表和章节位置。
validationRoadmap: connect provenance to tooltips and popovers
separate verified and pending evidence paths
validationRoadmapZh: 将来源连接到 tooltip 和弹窗
区分已核查和 pending 证据路径

methodGroups.title: Field-level provenance model
methodGroups.purpose: Make every important field explain where it came from and how strongly it can be used.
methodGroups.purposeZh: 让每个重要字段都能解释来源以及可使用强度。

algorithmSteps.label: Identify critical field
algorithmSteps.description: Select fields that drive scores, comparisons, or warnings.
algorithmSteps.descriptionZh: 选择影响评分、比较或警告的字段。

algorithmSteps.label: Attach source context
algorithmSteps.description: Store title, DOI, figure/table/section, evidence type, and status.
algorithmSteps.descriptionZh: 存储标题、DOI、图/表/章节、证据类型和状态。

algorithmSteps.label: Render warning when needed
algorithmSteps.description: Show pending or mixed-condition warnings near the value.
algorithmSteps.descriptionZh: 在数值旁显示 pending 或条件混合警告。

visualizations.title: Provenance popover
visualizations.description: Anchored explanation for field, value, condition, method, source, location, evidence type, and status.
visualizations.descriptionZh: 锚定展示字段、数值、条件、方法、来源、位置、证据类型和状态。

limitations: Pending source fields should not be used as benchmark evidence.
limitationsZh: source pending 字段不应作为基准证据使用。

summary: Limitations make demonstration, seed, curated literature, and reviewed evidence boundaries explicit across the platform.
summaryZh: 限制说明明确平台中 demonstration、seed、curated literature 和 reviewed evidence 的边界。

methodWorkflow.label: State data boundary
methodWorkflow.description: Disclose whether a record is demonstration, seed, curated literature, reviewed, pending, or missing.
methodWorkflow.descriptionZh: 说明记录是 demonstration、seed、curated literature、reviewed、pending 还是 missing。

methodWorkflow.label: Avoid validation claims
methodWorkflow.description: Do not treat decision-support labels as measured results.
methodWorkflow.descriptionZh: 不将决策支持标签当作实测结果。

methodWorkflow.label: Plan validation
methodWorkflow.description: Connect missing evidence to literature curation, DFT, or experiment steps.
methodWorkflow.descriptionZh: 将缺失证据连接到文献整理、DFT 或实验步骤。

visualizations.title: Validation roadmap cards
visualizations.description: Show what must be curated, computed, or measured next.
visualizations.descriptionZh: 展示下一步需要整理、计算或测量的内容。

evidenceBoundary: No module output is a validated scientific conclusion without external validation.
Decision-support views should remain tied to evidence level and curation status.
evidenceBoundaryZh: 没有外部验证时，任何模块输出都不是已验证科研结论。
决策支持视图必须绑定证据等级和整理状态。

methodGroups.title: Validation roadmap
methodGroups.purpose: Translate evidence limitations into concrete next validation tasks.
methodGroups.purposeZh: 将证据限制转化为具体后续验证任务。

algorithmSteps.label: Review source
algorithmSteps.description: Verify DOI, figure, table, and section references.
algorithmSteps.descriptionZh: 核验 DOI、图、表和章节。

algorithmSteps.label: Compute missing descriptors
algorithmSteps.description: Use DFT or curated databases where appropriate.
algorithmSteps.descriptionZh: 必要时使用 DFT 或整理数据库。

algorithmSteps.label: Run experiment
algorithmSteps.description: Measure task-specific outputs under comparable conditions.
algorithmSteps.descriptionZh: 在可比条件下测量任务特定输出。

algorithmSteps.label: Update evidence status
algorithmSteps.description: Move records from pending or estimated toward reviewed when justified.
algorithmSteps.descriptionZh: 有依据时将记录从 pending 或 estimated 更新为 reviewed。

visualizations.title: Roadmap steps
visualizations.description: Literature, DFT, experiment, and status update sequence.
visualizations.descriptionZh: 文献、DFT、实验和状态更新序列。

limitations: Roadmap tasks are plans until completed and reviewed.
limitationsZh: 验证路线在完成和复核前仍是计划。
